desktop.accountDevices.reach: In the desktop app, open your account’s Devices panel, which lists this computer by name.

desktop.cannotReach.reach: In the desktop app, pointed at a server that has stopped answering, the page shown in the window.

desktop.connectToServer.reach: Open the desktop app for the first time, before it has been pointed at a server; the screen asking which Valence is yours.

desktop.discord.reach: With Discord open on the same computer and the desktop app playing a film, a song, or on the library, look at your own Discord profile’s activity status.

desktop.downloadDialog.reach: In the desktop app, signed in as a viewer, open a film's detail dialog from the home page and choose Download.

desktop.downloads.reach: In the desktop app, open the Downloads panel after a download to this computer has failed.

desktop.menuBar.reach: In the desktop app, the application menu along the top of the screen on a Mac, or the File and View menus in the window on Windows and Linux; also the menu from right-clicking the window.

desktop.windowBar.reach: Open the desktop app; the bar across the top of its window.

phone.aChoiceOfEpisodes.reach: Home tab → Shows → tap a programme → Download → Choose episodes in the menu.

phone.album.reach: Home tab → Music → tap an album under Recently added.

phone.albums.reach: Home tab → Music → See all beside Recently added.

phone.artist.reach: Home tab → Music → tap an artist under Artists.

phone.artists.reach: Home tab → Music → See all beside Artists.

phone.askable.reach: Search tab, as somebody allowed to ask for things → type the name of a film not in the library → tap it under Not in your library yet.

phone.book.reach: Home tab → Books → tap a book.

phone.browsing.reach: Search tab → Discover → See all beside one of the rows.

phone.devicesSheet.reach: Play a song, open the music player from the bar along the bottom, then tap the cast button beside the lyrics button.

phone.downloads.reach: Downloads tab, with at least one film or episode kept on the phone.

phone.libraryBooks.reach: Home tab → Books in the row along the top.

phone.libraryFilms.reach: Home tab → Films in the row along the top.

phone.libraryHome.reach: Launch the app signed in: the Home tab, on Home in the row along the top.

phone.libraryMusic.reach: Home tab → Music in the row along the top.

phone.libraryShows.reach: Home tab → Shows in the row along the top.

phone.listening.reach: Open an audiobook's page, play a chapter, then tap the bar along the bottom showing what is playing.

phone.musicPlayer.reach: Play a song, then tap the bar along the bottom showing what is playing.

phone.musicPlayerUpNext.reach: Play an album, open the music player from the bar along the bottom, then tap the Up next button at the bottom right.

phone.notifications.reach: Home tab → the bell at the top.

phone.person.reach: Open a film's page and tap somebody in its cast.

phone.playlist.reach: Home tab → Music → tap one of Your playlists.

phone.playlistDetails.reach: Home tab → Music → New playlist under Your playlists; or open a playlist of one's own → More → Edit details.

phone.search.reach: Search tab, with something typed into the search box.

phone.searchRequested.reach: Search tab, as somebody allowed to ask for things → Requested.

phone.shareSheet.reach: Open a film's page and tap Share. For an episode, open a programme, tap an episode, then Share.

phone.show.reach: Home tab → Shows → tap a programme's poster.

phone.signInATelevision.reach: Home tab → the scan button at the top right, then scan the code a television shows.

phone.stillWatching.reach: Play an episode of a programme and let several episodes play on by themselves until the app asks whether anybody is still watching.

phone.theServerIsAway.reach: Signed in, stop the server: the notice along the top saying it cannot be reached.

phone.theWayIn.reach: Signed out, launch the app once a server has been chosen: the sign-in screen.

phone.theWayInCode.reach: Signed out, tap the profile of an account with two-step sign in on, and type its password.

phone.theWayInPassword.reach: Signed out, on the sign-in screen, tap a profile that has a password.

phone.title.reach: Home tab → Films → tap a film's poster.

phone.trackMenu.reach: Home tab → Music → open an album → tap the menu button beside any song.

phone.watching.reach: Open a film's page → Play, then tap the picture to show the controls.

phone.watchingSettings.reach: Play a film with subtitles, tap the picture to show the controls, then tap the settings button at the top right.

phone.whereIsYourValence.reach: Launch the app with no server remembered, or Account tab → Use a different server.

server.discord.reach: As an administrator, Admin → System → Webhooks, add a Discord webhook, then press Test or cause an event such as a sign-in or a library scan; the message appears in the Discord channel.

server.webhook.reach: As an administrator, Admin → System → Webhooks, add a webhook in the plain-text (Slack-style) format, then cause an event such as a sign-in or a library scan; the message arrives at the receiver.

tv.account.reach: Signed in on the television, choose your own face at the right-hand end of the bar along the top.

tv.ask.reach: Signed in on the television as somebody who may request, open Search, type a title the library does not have, and choose it under “Not in your library yet”.

tv.book.reach: On the television’s Books tab, choose an audiobook.

tv.books.reach: Signed in on a television whose server has audiobooks, the Books tab in the bar along the top.

tv.chooseServer.reach: On a television that has not yet chosen a server, the first screen; or from Account, press “Use a different server”.

tv.enterPassword.reach: On the television’s screen of faces, choose a face that has a password.

tv.film.reach: Signed in on the television, open the Films tab and choose a film.

tv.home.reach: Signed in on the television, the Home tab in the bar along the top.

tv.listening.reach: On the television, open an audiobook and press Play.

tv.music.reach: Signed in on a television whose server has music, the Music tab in the bar along the top.

tv.musicCollection.reach: On the television’s Music tab, choose an album, artist or playlist.

tv.nowPlaying.reach: On the television, play a song from the Music tab and open the now-playing chip.

tv.nowPlayingDevices.reach: On the television’s now-playing screen, press “Play on another device”.

tv.nowPlayingQueue.reach: On the television’s now-playing screen, press “Up next”.

tv.phoneSignIn.reach: On a television with nobody signed in, where the server hides its faces, the screen showing a code to scan with a phone.

tv.player.reach: On the television, play a film, and press the remote’s touch surface to bring up the controls.

tv.playerSettings.reach: In the television’s player, bring up the controls and press Settings.

tv.playerStats.reach: In the television’s player, press Settings and switch on “Stats for nerds”.

tv.playerUpNext.reach: In the television’s player, watch an episode of a programme to its closing credits, when the next episode is offered.

tv.requests.reach: On the television’s Account page, as somebody who may request, press “All requests”.

tv.search.reach: Signed in on the television, choose the magnifying glass at the left-hand end of the bar along the top, and type something.

tv.show.reach: Signed in on the television, open the Shows tab and choose a programme.

tv.whoIsWatching.reach: On a television that has chosen its server but has nobody signed in, the screen of faces.

web.accountDevices.reach: Signed in, open the account dialog from your face in the top bar and choose the Devices tab.

web.accountHidden.reach: Signed in, open the account dialog from your face in the top bar and choose the Hidden tab.

web.accountHistory.reach: Signed in, open the account dialog from your face in the top bar and choose the History tab.

web.accountLinks.reach: Signed in, open the account dialog from your face in the top bar and choose the Links tab.

web.accountProfile.reach: Signed in, open the account menu from your face in the top bar and choose the Profile tab of the account dialog.

web.accountSecurity.reach: Signed in, open the account dialog from your face in the top bar and choose the Security tab.

web.accountSecurityPasskey.reach: Signed in, open the account dialog, choose the Security tab and add a passkey.

web.accountSecurityTwoFactor.reach: Signed in, open the account dialog, choose the Security tab and set up two-factor authentication.

web.adminAccounts.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then People → Accounts in the sidebar.

web.adminActivity.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Activity → Sessions in the sidebar.

web.adminActivityMessage.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Activity → Sessions in the sidebar, then the message button on a session that is playing something, which opens the Message dialog.

web.adminActivityStats.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Activity → Sessions in the sidebar, then the Stream stats (info) button on a session that is playing a video, which opens the Stream stats panel.

web.adminAddLibrary.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin → Libraries, then the Add library button, which opens the Add a library dialog.

web.adminDownloads.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Requests → Downloads in the sidebar.

web.adminDownloadsRemove.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Requests → Downloads in the sidebar, then Remove on a download, which opens the Remove download dialog.

web.adminEncoding.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Content → Encoding in the sidebar.

web.adminEncodingReencode.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin → Encoding, then choose Re-encode to open the re-encode dialog.

web.adminEncodingReview.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin → Encoding, then choose a finished re-encode to review it.

web.adminFiles.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Content → Files in the sidebar.

web.adminIndexers.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Requests → Indexers in the sidebar.

web.adminJobs.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Activity → Jobs & logs in the sidebar.

web.adminJobsConfirmRun.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Activity → Jobs & logs; choose Run now from the menu of a job that deletes something and needs no library, which asks before starting it.

web.adminJobsHealth.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin → Jobs & Logs, then the Health view.

web.adminJobsLogRecord.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin → Jobs & Logs, the Logs view; choose any line of the log to open its record beside it.

web.adminJobsLogs.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin → Jobs & Logs, then the Logs view.

web.adminJobsRunIssues.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin → Jobs & Logs; on a job run's row open the ⋯ menu and choose View issues.

web.adminJobsRunLibraryJob.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Activity → Jobs & logs; press Run on a job that works on libraries, which opens the dialog asking which libraries to run it on.

web.adminJobsSchedule.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Activity → Jobs & logs; press into a job to open its schedule, the list of triggers that make it run.

web.adminJobsStop.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Activity → Jobs & logs while a job is running; choose Stop it from its menu, which asks before stopping it.

web.adminJobsTrace.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin → Jobs & Logs; choose any row in the job runs table to open its trace.

web.adminLibraries.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Content → Libraries in the sidebar.

web.adminLibrariesDelete.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Content → Libraries; choose Delete library from a library’s menu, which asks before deleting it.

web.adminLibrariesReread.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Content → Libraries; choose Read every file again from a library’s menu, which asks before starting.

web.adminLibrariesReset.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Content → Libraries; open the menu at the top of the panel and choose Reset and rebuild, which asks before starting.

web.adminLibrariesRunningWork.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Content → Libraries while a scan is running; press the running-work button to open the dialog listing what is under way.

web.adminLibrariesSettings.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Content → Libraries; open a library’s settings from its row, or add a library.

web.adminLibrariesUpload.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Content → Libraries; press Upload to open the dialog for sending files to the server.

web.adminMedia.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Content → Media in the sidebar.

web.adminMediaDelete.reach: Signed in as an administrator allowed to delete media, Admin, then Content → Media; choose Delete file… or Delete series… from an item’s menu, which asks before deleting.

web.adminMediaMatch.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Content → Media; choose Fix match on an item to open the dialog for picking what it really is.

web.adminMediaRebuild.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Content → Media; choose Rebuild previews from an item’s menu, which asks before starting.

web.adminOverview.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Overview in the sidebar.

web.adminProfiles.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Requests → Profiles in the sidebar.

web.adminProfilesEditor.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Requests → Profiles in the sidebar, then Add media profile (or Change in a profile’s actions menu). The dialog has Quality, Matching and Access tabs.

web.adminProfilesRemove.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Requests → Profiles in the sidebar, then Remove in a profile’s actions menu.

web.adminRequested.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Requests → Requested in the sidebar.

web.adminRequestedAsk.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Requests → Requested in the sidebar, then the button to ask for something new, which opens the Ask for media dialog.

web.adminRequestedDetail.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Requests → Requested in the sidebar, then click a request to open its detail dialog. Its tabs are How it is going, Releases, What it has done and Never again.

web.adminRequestedRefuse.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Requests → Requested in the sidebar, then Refuse on a pending request, which opens the Refuse dialog.

web.adminRequests.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Requests → Overview in the sidebar.

web.adminRoles.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then People → Roles in the sidebar.

web.adminRolesCreate.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then People → Roles in the sidebar, then Create role in the corner of the Roles card.

web.adminRolesDelete.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then People → Roles in the sidebar, then the … menu on a role and Delete role.

web.adminRolesEdit.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then People → Roles in the sidebar, then the … menu on a role and Edit role.

web.adminSearch.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Requests → Search in the sidebar.

web.adminSettings.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then System → Settings in the sidebar.

web.adminShares.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Activity → Links in the sidebar.

web.adminSharesWithdraw.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then Activity → Links in the sidebar, then the withdraw (broken link) button on a live link, which opens the Withdraw this link? dialog.

web.adminWebhooks.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then System → Webhooks in the sidebar.

web.adminWebhooksAdd.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then System → Webhooks in the sidebar, then Create webhook in the corner of the Webhooks card. Its Where, Events and Who tabs each show a different part of the form.

web.adminWebhooksCreated.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then System → Webhooks in the sidebar, straight after making a webhook with Create webhook, while its signing secret is still shown.

web.adminWebhooksDelete.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then System → Webhooks in the sidebar, then Delete on a webhook.

web.adminWebhooksEdit.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then System → Webhooks in the sidebar, then the … menu on a webhook and Edit.

web.adminWebhooksHistory.reach: Signed in as an administrator, Admin, then System → Webhooks in the sidebar, then History on a webhook that has sent something, one delivery of which failed.

web.askDialog.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open Requests, search for a film, series, artist or album that is not in the library, and choose it to open its dialog.

web.askable.reach: Signed in as a viewer, on Requests choose a series that is not in the library yet; the dialog for requesting it.

web.askableArtist.reach: Signed in as a viewer, on Requests → Music choose an artist that is not in the library yet; the dialog for requesting them.

web.audiobookPlayer.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open Books, open an audiobook and press Listen; the small player in the corner, opened with its arrow button to show the panel with chapters, speed and sleep timer.

web.bookDialog.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open Books and choose any book to open its dialog; for the chapter list, choose a book with several chapters.

web.books.reach: Signed in as a viewer, choose Books in the navigation bar.

web.chooseProfile.reach: Sign in to an account with several profiles; the screen asking who is watching.

web.confirmDelete.reach: Any dialog asking whether to delete something, such as deleting a download from the Downloads panel.

web.decideForSomebody.reach: Signed in as an administrator, open any film's detail dialog and choose 'Who may watch this' from its menu; the panel beside the dialog.

web.device.reach: Signed in, open /device in a browser, as a television's sign-in screen asks you to; the page for typing the television's code.

web.downloads.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open a film and choose Download to keep it, then open the Downloads dialog from the account menu to see it being prepared.

web.favourites.reach: Signed in as a viewer, choose Favourites in the navigation bar.

web.films.reach: Signed in as a viewer, choose Films in the navigation bar.

web.finishOnAnotherDevice.reach: Sign in on a television's browser to a household that has not been set up yet; the screen asking to finish setting up on a phone.

web.home.reach: Signed in as a viewer, the home page.

web.householdOnboarding.reach: Sign in for the first time to a household that has not been set up; the three-step 'Set up your household' panel (name, picture, passkey).

web.householdWelcome.reach: Finish the household onboarding on a brand-new server, after naming the household; the welcome page that follows.

web.keptPlayer.reach: In the desktop app, open Downloads from the top bar and play something that has been downloaded to this device; to see the message, open the address of a download that has been deleted.

web.listeningParty.reach: Signed in as a viewer, play a song on Music, open the listening party panel from the player and start a party.

web.mediaDetail.reach: Signed in as a viewer, on the home page choose any film or show card to open its detail dialog.

web.music.reach: Signed in as a viewer, choose Music in the navigation bar.

web.musicAlbum.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open Music and choose any album.

web.musicAlbums.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open Music and choose See all beside Recently added, or Albums in the library.

web.musicArtist.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open Music and choose any artist.

web.musicArtists.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open Music and choose See all beside Artists.

web.musicDevices.reach: Signed in as a viewer, play a song, then choose the devices button in the player bar to open the Play on another device panel.

web.musicImmersive.reach: Signed in as a viewer, play a song, then choose the artwork in the player bar to open the full-window immersive player.

web.musicLiked.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open Music and choose Liked Songs in the library down the left.

web.musicLyrics.reach: Signed in as a viewer, play a song, then choose the lyrics button in the player bar along the bottom.

web.musicParty.reach: Signed in as a viewer, play a song, then choose the listening party button in the player bar to open the Listening party panel.

web.musicPlaylist.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open Music and choose one of your playlists in the library down the left; its More menu holds the sharing, edit and delete items.

web.musicPlaylistDelete.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open one of your playlists in Music, open its More menu and choose Delete playlist to open the confirm dialog.

web.musicPlaylists.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open Music and choose See all beside Your playlists.

web.musicQueue.reach: Signed in as a viewer, play a song, then choose the queue button in the player bar to open the Queue panel on the right.

web.musicSearch.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open Music and type into the Search music field at the top of the library.

web.musicVideo.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open Music and, on a song that has a music video, choose Watch the video to open the video dialog.

web.musicVisualiser.reach: Signed in as a viewer, play a song, open the immersive player from the artwork in the player bar, then choose the Visualiser button.

web.new.reach: Signed in as a viewer, choose New in the navigation bar.

web.notifications.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open the bell in the top bar to see the notifications list.

web.nowPlaying.reach: Signed in as a viewer, start a song or a video playing on another device; the now playing bar along the bottom of the window.

web.offline.reach: Open Valence while the server cannot be reached; the offline screen with the files kept on this device.

web.openInTheApp.reach: Open Valence in a phone browser; the banner offering to open the app.

web.pageProblem.reach: Open an address that does not exist, or one whose page failed to load.

web.personDialog.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open a title and choose a person in its cast.

web.phoneSignIn.reach: Open the address a phone shows when it asks to be signed in from a browser.

web.phoneSignInSignedOut.reach: While signed out in this browser, open the address a phone shows when it asks to be signed in from a browser; the page offering a passkey first.

web.playOn.reach: While something plays, choose Play on… in the player to send it to another device.

web.playlistDialog.reach: Signed in as a viewer, on Music choose New playlist, or edit a playlist.

web.previewMoment.reach: Signed in as an administrator, open a film's detail dialog and choose to set its preview moment; the dialog for choosing it.

web.pushNotification.reach: A system notification from a browser that has allowed push notifications, when the server sends one without its own title or text.

web.read.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open a book from Books and choose Read.

web.readPanel.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open a book from Books and choose Read, then open the panel from the button in the reader's top right corner.

web.requests.reach: Signed in as a viewer, choose Requests in the navigation bar.

web.requestsBooks.reach: Signed in as a viewer, choose Requests in the navigation bar, then the Books tab.

web.requestsCancel.reach: On Requests → the Requests tab, choose Cancel on one of your requests; the dialog confirming it.

web.requestsMine.reach: Signed in as a viewer who has requested something, choose Requests in the navigation bar, then the Requests tab.

web.requestsMovies.reach: Signed in as a viewer, choose Requests in the navigation bar, then the Movies tab.

web.requestsMusic.reach: Signed in as a viewer, choose Requests in the navigation bar, then the Music tab.

web.search.reach: Signed in as a viewer, choose Search in the navigation bar and type a title.

web.seriesDialog.reach: Signed in as a viewer, on Books choose a series in a book rail to open its dialog.

web.serverUnreachable.reach: Open Valence in a browser while its server is stopped, before anything has been kept for offline use; the page saying it is not reachable.

web.setupWizard.reach: Open a brand-new Valence server for the first time; the setup wizard.

web.share.reach: Open a share link someone sent, while signed out.

web.shareBook.reach: Open a share link someone sent for a book, while signed out.

web.shareDialog.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open a title and choose Share.

web.shareEnded.reach: Open a share link that has been withdrawn or has run out; the page saying it no longer works.

web.showDialog.reach: Signed in as a viewer, choose any show card to open its dialog.

web.showDialogChooseEpisodes.reach: Signed in as a viewer in the desktop app, open a show's dialog, choose Download, then Choose episodes; the dialog for picking which to keep.

web.showDialogTrailer.reach: Signed in as a viewer, open a show's dialog and choose Watch the trailer.

web.shows.reach: Signed in as a viewer, choose Shows in the navigation bar.

web.signIn.reach: Open Valence while signed out; the sign-in screen.

web.splash.reach: Open Valence in a browser; the splash screen shown for a moment while it asks the server whether it has been set up.

web.stillWatching.reach: Let several episodes play on their own without touching anything until the Are you still watching? dialog appears.

web.televisionHandoff.reach: Sign in on a television that shows a code, then open the address it shows in a browser.

web.twoFactorChallenge.reach: Sign in to an account with two-factor authentication switched on; the screen asking for the code.

web.videoRemote.reach: Signed in as a viewer while this account plays something on another device; open the remote from the now playing bar.

web.watch.reach: Signed in as a viewer, choose any film and press Play; the full-window player with its controls showing.

web.watchParty.reach: In the player, open the watch party menu from the control bar and start or join a party.

web.watchPartyPassword.reach: Open a link to a watch party that has a password; the dialog asking for it.

web.watchStats.reach: Signed in as a viewer, play a film that the server has to convert, open the player's settings and switch on Stats for nerds.

web.watchTracks.reach: In the player, open the audio and subtitles menu from the control bar.

web.welcomeTour.reach: Sign in to a new account for the first time; the welcome tour.
